period.description: Latest twelve complete calendar months; current partial month excluded

clock.definition: Daily spread is the mean settlement price in hours ending 20 and 21 minus the mean in hours ending 11 through 14, Central time, delivery date. The stored spread is the mean of those daily spreads. Negative days stay in. This is the clock in data/zone-value.json (charge late morning, discharge the early evening). It is not an optimized dispatch.
